Rafael — drafted two clean options below and attached the proposal + amortization workbook. High level: we can support a deferment, but it needs to be coupled with either a shorter pilot credit window (Option B) or a modest prepayment holdback to protect platform capacity.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Starter_Proposal.pdf, amortization_schedule.xlsx

Option A — Amortized annual model (recommended for baseline predictability)
- Platform fee (annual): €120,000
- Amortization: 12 months = €10,000/month; can defer first 3 months at no charge OR defer 6 months with a 6% deferral fee (one-time) to cover provisioning hold.
- Node licenses: €8,000 per node/year (10-node starter = €80,000)
- Support: Standard (included), Enhanced Oncall + SRE retainer available as add-ons (see pricing bands in sheet).
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice for amortized platform + monthly node/license pro rata.

Option B — Consumption-first (pilot-oriented)
- Initial platform fee: €40,000 (discounted starter fee) + 60,000 in pilot credits (applied to node-hours).
- Metering: node-hour buckets billed monthly at €0.30 / node-hour after credits expire.
- Node capacity: reserved node pool for the pilot (10 nodes reserved, unused hours roll to the next month for first 3 months).
- Support: Enhanced Oncall available; Enterprise SRE retainer required if they want 24/7 coverage during pilot.

Support tiers (summary)
- Standard: Business hours SLA, email + ticketing (included)
- Enhanced Oncall: 24/7 alerting + 4-hr response weekdays (€6,000/month)
- Enterprise SRE: Dedicated SRE retainer for runbook + escalations (€22,000/month)

Notes:
- We recommend Option A amortized with a 3-month defer. If they insist on 6 months, suggest the 6% deferral fee to balance capacity risk.
- Attached amortization_schedule.xlsx models both 3- and 6-month defer scenarios and monthly cashflow.

Next steps: Rafael, can you present this to Nora and see which route they prefer? If they want Net 45 terms and 6-month deferment, we'll need Soojin/legal to confirm the deferral fee structure.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the options look good. A few follow-ups from procurement and finance: 

1) Deferment term: NovaMed preference is 6 months (our budget window). We accept the 6% deferral fee you proposed if necessary, but would prefer deferment with staggered invoicing rather than a lump deferral charge.
2) Metering: we'd like the monthly node-hour buckets (Option B) but with a guaranteed floor (for budgeting) — e.g., a minimum 6,000 node-hours / month for the first 6 months, then true-up monthly.
3) Invoice terms: Procurement requests Net 45. They will attach our PO template to the contract; I have included it as an attachment.

Can you provide a redlineable commercial term sheet (1 page) we can attach to the SOW and a revised amortization schedule that shows the 6-month staggered deferment (monthly minimal payments of €5k during months 1–6, then ramp to amortized amounts)?

Attached: NovaMed_PO_Template.docx
